digest.component_or_area: build-provenance semantics tests and artifact-probe workflow
propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures materialize all 3,019 checkout files although production hatch_build.py requires only three files, causing avoidable per-worker build overhead
Xdist runtime on -n 3 --dist initializes the session fixture independently on all three workers, each paying 6.60-6.74s setup, amplifying the full-checkout cost

The artifact-probe workflow uses trusted-main GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving git rev-parse HEAD after final checkout, causing it to accept wrong but nonempty patchset provenance in violation of exact-source identity

The minimal three-file committed package fixture with real isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel builds through production hatch_build.py must preserve env override, Git fallback, blank-env failure, and exact COMMIT identity in every OS/Python cell
Both workflow lanes must derive expected SHA using git rev-parse --short HEAD after their final lane-specific checkout and require exact equality for installed wheel and sdist
